about: Connect a cloud service (DASH-452): the services the wizard offers, in the order shown, with each field's words. One list for the page (web/js/cloud-wizard.js) and the checks on the server (starboard/cloud_connect.py), so they cannot drift. Sign-in: oauth services sign in with the service's own page; keys services take keys or a password here.

services.name: Google Drive
services.line: Sign in with your Google account.
services.folder_note: Starboard can only see the folders it made itself, so a new folder is the usual choice.

services.name: OneDrive
services.line: Sign in with your Microsoft account.

services.name: Dropbox
services.line: Sign in with your Dropbox account.

services.name: Backblaze B2
services.line: An application key from your Backblaze account.
services.folder_note: The first part is the bucket, such as my-backups/starboard. The key must be allowed to write to it.

fields.label: Application key ID
fields.hint: From Backblaze: Application keys, Add a new application key.

fields.label: Application key
fields.hint: Shown once, when the key is made. Kept by Starboard only.

services.name: An S3-compatible service
services.line: Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, MinIO and others.
services.folder_note: The first part is the bucket, such as my-backups/starboard.

fields.label: Address of the service
fields.hint: Such as https://s3.eu-west-2.wasabisys.com. Leave it empty for Amazon S3.

fields.label: Region
fields.hint: Such as eu-west-2. Leave it empty if the service does not use one.

fields.label: Access key ID
fields.hint: From the service's keys or API page.

services.name: Nextcloud or another WebDAV server
services.line: Your own Nextcloud, ownCloud or WebDAV address.

fields.label: WebDAV address
fields.hint: For Nextcloud: Files, Files settings, WebDAV, such as https://cloud.example/remote.php/dav/files/alex/.

fields.label: Kind of server
fields.hint: Nextcloud and ownCloud keep the file times right.

fields.label: Password
fields.hint: For Nextcloud, make an app password: Personal settings, Security, Create new app password. Kept by Starboard only.

services.name: An SFTP server
services.line: Another computer or a NAS you can reach with SSH.

fields.label: Computer
fields.hint: Its name or address, such as 192.168.1.20 or nas.home.

services.name: Your own rclone remote
services.line: Paste the part of your rclone.conf for a remote you made already.
